READY ON ENABLE: no bake, no install step - but switching it OFF only frees the sounds after a restart.
Replaces three shipped geoscape UI sounds with the author's own, all under one second. Requires the ContentTool mod.
CONTENT ONLY - this mod ships no DLL at all. Its three replacement banks are shipped ALREADY BUILT in Dist\Sounds, and ContentTool loads every one of them into memory at startup, so a download plays as it stands: measured 2026-08-28 with no bake command ever run, the three sounds came back 1200 -> 888 ms, 3533 -> 456 ms and 2231 -> 914 ms, all served from memory while an untouched shipped sound in the same run still streamed from its file. No game file is touched, so there is nothing to revert - but Wwise will not fall back to the shipped media after an unload, which is why turning the mod off needs a restart. 'ct_sound bake ReplaceUiSounds' is the AUTHOR's command, for rebuilding those banks after editing Content\Audio; a player never needs it. Its twin, ContentTool Demo: Add UI Sounds, does the other half - adding sounds the game never had - and needs a DLL for it.
